matrix_name.name: polyimine
matrix_name.description: Biobased polyimine network film (BQP-10Si / BS), prepared from TFMP + (6FAPB:TPE-Q = 1:1) with siloxane diamine BTD at 10% molar ratio of total diamines; used as polymer substrate for BS/GF composites.

fillers.name: graphite felt
fillers.description: Polyacrylonitrile-based graphite felt (GF); cleaned (water/ethanol sonication cycles) and thermally oxidized in air at 420 °C for 10 h before impregnation.
